title: Let There Be Light
status: Two original synthetic vocal choices + instrumental
description: An original song adaptation inspired by Genesis 1, with an intentionally robotic synthetic vocal draft and an instrumental version. The reference Scripture is the public-domain Berean Standard Bible.

sections.label: Day one · Light
lines: Before the dawn, before the day,
The earth lay dark, without a form.
God’s Spirit moved above the deep;
God spoke, and light began to dawn.

sections.label: Day two · Sky
lines: God spoke, and stretched the sky above,
Between the waters, wide and high.
The evening passed, the morning came;
A second day beneath the sky.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let there be light, let there be light;
The Maker speaks, the world awakes.
And all He made was very good;
We sing the wonder of His works.

sections.label: Day three · Land and life
lines: The waters drew to seas below;
The dry land rose where grass would grow.
Each tree bore fruit, each plant its seed;
God saw the good in all that grew.

sections.label: Day four · Sun, moon and stars
lines: The greater light would rule the day;
The lesser light would rule the night.
The stars would shine, the seasons turn;
God filled the heavens with their light.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let there be light, let there be light;
The Maker speaks, the world awakes.
And all He made was very good;
We sing the wonder of His works.

sections.label: Day five · Sea and sky
lines: The waters teemed with living things;
The birds took flight across the sky.
God blessed their life to fill the seas,
To spread their wings and multiply.

sections.label: Day six · Life on earth
lines: God made the creatures of the earth,
And in His image, woman, man.
He blessed them, gave the earth to tend,
And plants for food across the land.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let there be light, let there be light;
The Maker speaks, the world awakes.

rights.composition: New lyrics, melody and synthesized arrangement prepared for Bible Songs. No external recordings or samples used.
rights.vocal: Rendered locally with the free eSpeak formant synthesizer and original note timing/DSP. Not a human voice recording or voice clone. No paid APIs used.
rights.adaptation: These song lyrics are an adaptation, not the verbatim Berean Standard Bible chapter.
rights.warmVocal: Kokoro-82M standard af_heart voice (Apache-2.0 model), run locally with kokoro-onnx (MIT), then processed with original singing DSP. No singer audio input, cloning or fine-tuning.
rights.compositeVocal: Pretrained Matcha-TTS/VCTK acoustic model and HiFi-GAN vocoder; speaker embeddings locally adapted on a selected LibriTTS-R subset, averaged across eight profiles, then original singing DSP. Machine-generated output. See voice4-credits.md for attribution and changes. Revised in 1.0.8 using local Praat/Parselmouth pulse-synchronous overlap-add, voicing-aware timing, syllable-note contours and echo-free mixing.
rights.voice3: Local Matcha-TTS full speech-model fine-tuning on a LibriTTS-R training set; checkpoint 500; mean of 124 male-labelled speaker embeddings; original word timing/PSOLA processing. Machine-generated; not singing-trained. Attribution and changes: voice3-credits.md. Revised in 1.0.7 with local Praat/Parselmouth pulse-synchronous overlap-add, voicing-aware timing, syllable-level notes and echo-free mixing.

recordings.name: Voice 1 · Male
recordings.description: Synthetic male voice with smooth pitch processing and a register matched to its speech identity.
recordings.creation: Rendered locally from the free Kokoro am_michael male neural profile. Singing uses the improved Praat pulse-based timing and pitch method, natural consonant timing, phrase-level gain and an echo-free mix. This is an existing licensed speech-model profile processed into singing, not a newly trained singer or celebrity copy. No paid service was used.
